name: designly
description: Designly is a senior commercial art-direction skill with Taste Engine, Reference Memory, design preflight, anti-slop gates, brand and product fidelity, Arabic RTL direction, manipulation physics, and visual QA.

interface.longDescription: Designly acts as a senior commercial Art Director. It turns references into evidence-backed taste rules, remembers them with stable REF IDs, assigns each reference a specific design job, resolves the marketing brief, preflights hierarchy and composition before generation, and reviews outputs with hard gates, category floors, originality controls, and an AI-slop veto.
defaultPrompt: Art-direct this brief using my saved references, then preflight and execute the visual.
Analyze these references into reusable taste rules and remember them with REF IDs.
Review this visual for design quality and AI slop, then fix the smallest failing layer.
